facts.learning_notes: git diff ignores untracked files, so the record job uses git status --porcelain or the first run would never create snapshot.txt. Defaults bound at definition time (fetch=fetch_text) defeat mock.patch, so the fetcher is looked up at call time.

facts.changes_summary: build-matrix.yml: cron '*/15 * * * *' replaces '0 */6 * * *', header comment explains the cadence and concurrency; README says every 15 minutes. Weekly full-rebuild cron unchanged.
facts.learning_notes: The user's '15 * * * *' means hourly at :15; every 15 minutes is '*/15 * * * *'. Concurrency keeps one run waiting, so a 15-minute cadence queues at most one run behind a long build.

auto_commit_on_completion.description: Auto-raise commit interaction when WorkNode completes with file_changes evidence

auto_enqueue.description: When on, ready work is always enqueued; the orchestrator only picks lanes, never whether to run it.

max_concurrent_works.description: Maximum number of WorkNodes in the running state concurrently

models.description: Model configuration per agentic provider, keyed by agent_provider() (e.g. 'claude-code'). Each entry: the active model+effort and an escalation ladder whose rungs carry their own effort.

enable_works_approval.description: Whether a captured WorkNode REQUIRES approval before it can be assigned (the gate itself, as opposed to enable_dialogs which is presentation only)

enable_dialogs.description: presentation only -- interactive dialogs vs plain textual messages; does not gate whether approval is required (see enable_works_approval)

only_external_approvals.description: When true, approvals are decided entirely outside the session. No approval cards, no AskUserQuestion, no approvals move, no Stop-hook block -- only external decision reports. Takes precedence over enable_dialogs for approvals.

enable_constraint_enforcement.description: Enable Stop-hook constraint freshness enforcement and automatic repair-work creation.

hold_stop_on_subagents.description: When true, the Stop hook blocks when sub-agents are running (existing behavior). When false, the Stop hook allows stopping even with sub-agents running.
